pol_recip.name: Make the dual of an octahedron, a cube.
Make the dual pair of an octahedron and a cube.
Make the dual pair of a cuboctahedron and rhombic dodecahedron, with — pol_recip -a -r f cubo | off_color -r A0.4,f
Make the dual pair of a cuboctahedron and rhombic dodecahedron, with — pol_recip -a -r F cubo | off_color -r A0.4,f (2)
Specify a face plane of a polyhedron by three of its — pol_recip -a -c 0,0,0.2 -r 2,3,5 pyr5 | off_color -r A0.4,f
Specify a face plane of a polyhedron by three of its — pol_recip -a -c 0,0,-0.4 -r 2,3,5 pyr5 | off_color -r A0.4,f
A canonical antihemaphrodite is self-dual, but not in the centroid — polygon ant -s antih 4 | canonical | pol_recip -a
A canonical antihemaphrodite is self-dual, but not — polygon ant -s antih 4 | canonical | pol_recip -a -c M -n 10000
pol_recip.command: polygon ant -s antih 4 | canonical | pol_recip -a -c M -n 10000
